criteria.criterion: Owner adopts all seven precise decisions and named scope; source hashes match frozen packet.
Schema v1 fields all mapped; decoded/encoded WORK values equal, including exact extension Number text; unknown/duplicate/unrepresentable inputs reject.
All expanded codec/store/legacy cases build, have exact oracle and fixture/fault reached; intended new behavior RED before implementation, zero invalid RED/skip.
Every declared behavior case and original correctly scoped regression GREEN; no weakening/deletion without explicit archived legacy migration.
No existing target/source/ESS/manifest/prefs corruption on conflicts, read errors, partial create or recovery; full before/after tree checked.
RecoveryRequired exact top-level paths retained; committed definition proof survives later prefs failure; no false global rollback.
HOST new flow invokes commit Port for writes/exclusive dirs only; forbidden direct write/mkdir/remove/native calls0; no owner/registry mutation.
All three deprecated HOST creators deny valid calls before FS; all three S3 routes remain an explicit release-blocking migration until native/UI accepted.
Full HOST, WORK, Ports/Adapters libs and standalone shell compatibility run with --locked; failures classified, all manifests/lock versions protected.
Windows11/native aliases, S3 authorization/request dedupe/late ack, full UI/install/release stay NOT RUN until their actual evidence exists.
